subject: Invoice delivery & entity split — Novus Health AP preferences
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery & entity split — Novus Health AP preferences

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — good to get AP involved early. To finalize our billing handoff for the pilot and then monthly production invoices, we need a quick confirmation on two items so we can wire up automated delivery:

1) Per-entity invoicing: you mentioned Novus prefers separate legal-entity invoices for tax/VAT reconciliation (Eastside Holdings vs Novus Health Services). Can you confirm which of the two legal names we should invoice for the March pilot? If you want both, we can emit two PDFs and a consolidated statement.

2) Delivery channel: we support (A) emailed PDF copies to a billing inbox, (B) SFTP drop (secure push) of a ZIP with PDF+CSV, (C) automated webhook (invoice JSON payload) to your accounting system, or (D) Portal-only (email notifications + downloadable invoices). Please tell us your preference and whether you need remittance advice as a separate CSV attachment or embedded in the PDF.

I've attached our lightweight invoice template and have included a sample CSV that matches the format our accounting team can export. Once you confirm, we'll:
- Provision the SFTP credentials / webhook endpoint test URL (if needed)
- Set the invoice sender address (billing@redwood.ai) and reply-to
- Ensure VAT registration numbers are present on the per-entity PDFs

If it's easiest, reply with the exact invoice-to legal name and "Email" or "SFTP" and we will proceed.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template_v2.pdf (sample PDF), monthly_breakdown_202802.csv (sample CSV)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novus Health AP Hub <ap+redwood@novushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & entity split — Novus Health AP preferences

Marissa,

Thanks — quick answers below:

- Invoice-to: please invoice "Novus Health Services, Inc." for the pilot. For any charge that is billed to Eastside Holdings we will flag that in the PO; otherwise default to Novus Health Services. We need the VAT/Tax ID for Novus Health Services on every invoice. Our VAT number is GB123456789 (we're cross-border on a small subset).

- Delivery: We prefer SFTP drop for production monthly invoices (company policy). For the pilot, please send PDFs to payables@novushealth.com AND place the same files on the SFTP so our AP team can validate. Remittance advice: CSV file is preferred (one line per invoice) — include invoice number, net, tax, and payment due date.

- PO: Attached is PO 4759 (already issued). Please reference it on the invoice.

One more ask — can you include an "accounting_code" field in the CSV so our ERP can auto-map charges? If not, include a CSV column called "GL_code" and we can map after ingestion.

Appreciate the help,

Liam O'Connor
Senior Manager, AP — Novus Health
liam.oconnor@novushealth.com

Attachments: Novus_PO_4759.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & entity split — Novus Health AP preferences

Hi Liam — perfect, thanks for the specifics. Quick follow-ups so implementation is clean: 

- We'll issue the pilot invoice to "Novus Health Services, Inc." and include VAT GB123456789 in the header.
- We'll push identical files to SFTP and CC payables@novushealth.com for the pilot. For production, we'll default to SFTP only unless you ask us to keep email copies as well.
- We can include a CSV named remittance_Novus_202803.csv with columns: invoice_number, net_amount, tax_amount, due_date, GL_code. That should satisfy your ERP mapping.
- PO 4759 will be referenced in the invoice's "Order/Reference" field.

Next steps from our side: Vivek, Ben — can you confirm who will request SFTP credentials and whether we should generate a one-time test drop or a daily/weekly folder structure? Also, is there any procurement onboarding (W-9/Cert) we need to attach for tax purposes?

Liam, I'll also send a DocuSign link if Novus requires a billing change authorization (quick checkbox form) — that helps us update our sender and legal-entity mapping.

Thanks,

Marissa
Billing Lead

Thanks Marissa — quick ops note:

- I'll open a ticket with infra to create an SFTP account (sftp-novus-redwood) and a test folder /incoming/novus/test. Ops will provision keys and we'll share credentials in a secure ticket to the Novus AP contact.
- Ben — can you prepare a one-off pilot invoice PDF using the template Marissa attached and include the remittance CSV. If Novus signs the DocuSign, we will flip to production SFTP-only and start sending invoices on the 1st of each month for that billing cycle.
- Procurement: I'll check if we require additional tax docs for the U.K. VAT case, but usually the VAT number on the invoice and the PO is sufficient for their reconciliation. If Novus requests a vendor form (W-9 equivalent or certificate), we'll loop Legal.

Liam — we will send the SFTP test credentials by Tuesday EOD PST. Ben will drop the pilot invoice by EOD today so you have it for internal validation.

Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
